description: Figure 2 illustrates the reliability score of different models across a range of cost values. The x-axis is labeled “Cost” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “Reliability Score” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 90, with tick labels at intervals of 10. There are three lines shown on the plot. The first line, representing “GPT-4”, is blue with circular markers and shows a generally increasing trend, starting at approximately 40 at a cost of 0 and rising to approximately 84 at a cost of 10. The second line, representing “RS0”, is orange with triangular markers and begins at approximately 72 at a cost of 0, declines to approximately 69 at a cost of 2, then rises to approximately 75 at a cost of 10. The third line, representing “RS10”, is green with square markers and starts at approximately 12 at a cost of 0, rises to approximately 16 at a cost of 2, and then declines to approximately 11 at a cost of 10.
